mapper.sql:
with recursive calendar as ( select #{startDt} as weight_dt
union all
select weight_dt + interval 1 day from calendar where weight_dt + interval 1 day < #{endDt} )
mapper.select: select calendar.weight_dt, weight.weight from calendar left join weight on weight.user_id = #{userId} and weight.weight_dt = calendar.weight_dt order by calendar.weight_dt

, ideal_weight as ( select cwg.st_dt, cwg.ed_dt, cwg.ideal_weight, (cwg.ideal_weight - cwg.weight_goal) / datediff(cwg.ed_dt, cwg.st_dt) as down_ideal_weight from ( select wg.st_dt, wg.ed_dt, wg.weight_goal, cast( case when datediff(wg.st_dt, lag(wg.ed_dt) over(order by wg.st_dt)) < 7 then lag(wg.weight_goal) over(order by wg.st_dt) else w.weight end as decimal(10, 6) ) as ideal_weight from weight_goal wg left join weight w on w.weight_dt = ( select max(w_t.weight_dt) from weight w_t where wg.user_id = w_t.user_id and wg.st_dt >= w_t.weight_dt ) where wg.user_id = '1' ) cwg where cwg.st_dt < #{endDt} and cwg.ed_dt >= #{startDt} union all
select st_dt + interval 1 day, ed_dt, ideal_weight - down_ideal_weight, down_ideal_weight from ideal_weight where st_dt < ed_dt )
select c.weight_dt, iw.ideal_weight from calendar c left join ( select st_dt as weight_dt, cast(round(ideal_weight, 1) as decimal(4, 1)) as ideal_weight from ideal_weight ) as iw on c.weight_dt = iw.weight_dt order by c.weight_dt
select calendar.weight_dt, weight.weight from calendar left join weight on weight.user_id = #{userId} and weight.weight_dt = calendar.weight_dt order by calendar.weight_dt
select calendar.weight_dt, weight.weight, weight.fat, weight.memo from calendar left join weight on weight.user_id = #{userId} and weight.weight_dt = calendar.weight_dt order by calendar.weight_dt
select * from weight where user_id = #{userId} and weight_dt = #{weightDt}
mapper.insert: insert into weight(user_id, weight_dt, weight, fat, memo) values(#{userId}, #{weightDt}, #{weight}, #{fat}, #{memo}) as params on duplicate key update weight = params.weight, fat = params.fat, memo = params.memo
mapper.select: select * from weight_goal where user_id = #{userId} and st_dt < #{endDt} and ed_dt >= #{startDt}
select * from weight_goal where user_id = #{userId} and #{clickDt} between st_dt and ed_dt
mapper.insert: insert into weight_goal(user_id, st_dt,ed_dt, weight_goal) values(#{userId}, #{stDt}, #{edDt}, #{weightGoal})
mapper.update: update weight_goal set st_dt = #{weightGoal.stDt}, ed_dt = #{weightGoal.edDt}, weight_goal = #{weightGoal.weightGoal} where user_id = #{weightGoal.userId} and ed_dt = #{eventDt}
mapper.delete: delete from weight_goal where user_id = #{userId} and ed_dt = #{eventDt}
